trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold. After the story, the 100% Completion Checklist opens at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and progress you made during the story already counts toward it. The checklist does not demand literally everything: you need 100 optional missions, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 70 of the 80 challenges, 300 of the 397 stunts, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, all 15 of Bret's Target Decks, 15 of the 18 meditations, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 30 of 40 unique races won, 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, the underwater discoveries and both unique playlists. Work it in the same order as the roadmap's Stage 2 and most other trophies fall out along the way.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge shown on each stunt is not required — performing the stunt once counts as completed. Track your count at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and show stunt spots on the map from Map, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy in the game that can be missed. There are 18 meditations across 10 meditation spots, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice — you can play as both characters after the mission Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The final spot, Ascent Mountain, only appears on the map once the others are done. The missable one is the very first meditation: during Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her out to the balcony and choose Accept. It raises your meditation counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the rest, so it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway, and make a manual save first. Track progress at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed; this trophy wants all of them.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops together. Clearing the flashing search area is not enough: you must escape the red heat zone as well. A reliable spot is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, which gives cover from helicopters and makes it harder for police cars to follow. Stay in the tunnel until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: games.gg — Complete GTA 6 Trophy List

steps: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Drive into the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County).
Wait in cover until the wanted level and the heat zone clear.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — the trick is the opposite of a normal escape: keep the red-and-blue flashing pursuit active between shops, because the trophy only counts the chain while your wanted level never drops. Remaining inside the red heat zone without an active wanted level does not count. Plan three close-together shops in advance, move fast between them, and note the trophy can pop about 30 seconds after you leave the third shop, so do not give up on a good run too early.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route.

Wait ~30 seconds after the third shop; the trophy may pop late.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus, then take down 5 enemies before the focus bar drains. Adrenaline extends how long Combat Focus lasts, and an assault rifle helps you work through a clustered group of gang enemies. Raising your Focus level at the shooting ranges makes the window more forgiving, so do this after some range practice.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First unlock the Snap Gun by finishing the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Then use the Snap Gun on a jewelry store's locked back door, find the safe-code note inside, and open the safe quietly — kicking the door in triggers the alarm and fails the run. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a suitable target. No alarms, no witnesses, no detection.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Ch. 3) to unlock the Snap Gun.
Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door (don't kick it).
Find the safe-code note inside, open the safe quietly.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: follow the security van to a bank and enter while the guard has the vault open. There are 8 vaults in total and all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist, so plan to do them all. Each vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway.

PlayStation tracks a running count of the choices you make, and this trophy pops once you have made enough of them across the story and side content. There is nothing to grind here: keep playing, take the choices the game offers whenever they appear, and it will come. No published guide has confirmed an exact count, so this entry does not invent one.

The plain reading is that it pops when you succeed at something on your second attempt after failing the first, so if an activity or challenge beats you once, go straight back and clear it on the retry. This entry flags it as unconfirmed rather than dressing a guess up as a method.

trophies.guide: The description reads like a reaction to something strange — and no published guide has confirmed what that something is yet. GTA games hide odd encounters around the map, so the working read is that this pops when you witness one of Leonida's strange sights, but no guide has pinned down which one. This entry flags it as unconfirmed rather than inventing a location.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl someone over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, strike a pedestrian with a melee weapon as you pass. Line up a slow drive past a pedestrian, swing the melee weapon from the vehicle, and the knockdown should count. It is the drive-by half of the bowling joke — the other half is the actual bowling alley in Let's Go Bowling.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and gang operations — and your contacts clean them into usable cash. Keep laundering as you work the robbery trophies and the total climbs on its own; it is a cumulative counter, not a single payout.

Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, anything sold in a shop counts toward the total. It is cumulative across the whole game, so normal spending during the story and the garage and vehicle purchases for other trophies will push it along. If you are short at the end, buy and sell high-value items until the counter clears $100,000.

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought through the in-game property market; save up during the story and the robbery runs, then buy each garage as you find it. The purchases also feed the $100,000 spending counter for Treat Yo Self.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like around Leonida, then register each one through the app — ten different vehicles and the trophy pops. It pairs well with Whip It Good: discover a vehicle, then register it before moving on.
